yuttāyuttivicāraṇa: (Na) [yuttāyutti+vicāraṇa] (thī) (1) (Saṃvaṇṇanā) which is cause of criticization for reasonable or not. (Thī, na) (2) Criticization and contemplation on it which is reasonable or not. (Thi).
